blocks.title: questions

items.q: How is working or volunteering at Badger Supports?
a: Working or volunteering at Badger Supports means joining a student-led team that is goal-oriented and focused on improving campus well-being.

Your role is designed to complement your career interests or academic studies, offering flexible scheduling, hands-on training, and opportunities to build leadership, communication, and project management skills.

items.q: Tell me more about your hiring process.
a: Applicants submit a Letter of Recommendation and Resume, complete a Written Application, and may include a Personal Portfolio or Sample that highlights their experience or creativity. Selected candidates are then invited to up to two interviews.

Interested students do not apply for a specific position. Instead, they share their interests and relevant experiences, and if selected, a role within Badger Supports is offered based on organizational needs and individual fit.

items.a: All Badger Supports Staff Positions are funded by the General Student Services Fund and are paid a flat $15.15 an hour.

items.q: Do I need prior experience for staff?
items.a: Previous experience through Badger Supports’ volunteer program or similar programs is preferred but not required. Training and mentorship are provided to help all team members succeed and grow within their roles at Badger Supports.

items.q: How much do volunteers or staff typically work?
a: Volunteers can be as involved as they choose, whether through short-term events or long-term projects.
Staff members typically have set weekly hours and ongoing responsibilities that align with their specific roles and goals within the organization.

blocks.note: Badger Supports values diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Accommodations can be requested at accessibility@badgersupports.org.
